item.title: Morgan Properties Completes $354 Million Acquisition Of Dream Residential REIT
item.description: Morgan Properties has closed a $354 million acquisition of Dream Residential Real Estate Investment Trust, completing a cross-border transaction that privatizes the publicly traded Canadian REIT and expands the company’s national footprint. The deal adds 15 communities totaling 3,300 units across major metropolitan areas in Texas, Ohio, Kentucky, and Oklahoma, marking one of the year’s most significant multifamily consolidations.

item.title: Icertis Acquires Dioptra To Accelerate AI First Contracting Capabilities
item.description: Icertis has acquired Dioptra in a move that significantly expands its AI-driven capabilities for enterprise contracting and advances its long-term strategy to create a fully autonomous contracting ecosystem. The transaction strengthens Icertis’ position as a leader in the contract lifecycle management market. It deepens the capabilities of its Icertis Contract Intelligence platform following the introduction of its AI framework, Vera.

item.title: Novvia Group Expands With Acquisition Of Aaron Packaging’s Distribution Business
item.description: Novvia Group has acquired the distribution assets of Washington-based Aaron Packaging, advancing its growth strategy in the Western United States and strengthening its national packaging distribution platform.

item.title: Allen Family Philanthropies Provides Nearly $7 Million To Strengthen Seattle Center Arts And Culture Programs
item.description: Allen Family Philanthropies has committed nearly $7 million in new funding to eight arts and culture organizations based on the Seattle Center campus, marking a significant investment in expanding access, education, and creative opportunities for young people across the region. The grants are designed to help grow diverse creator pipelines, broaden participation in youth-oriented cultural programming, and reimagine spaces that serve millions of annual visitors.

item.title: Opti9 Acquires Aptible To Expand Managed Cloud And Compliance Capabilities
item.description: Opti9 Technologies has acquired Aptible, broadening its footprint across managed cloud services, application modernization, and compliant platform solutions.

item.title: Finance Of America To Buy Reverse Mortgage Assets From PHH Mortgage
item.description: Finance Of America Reverse, the reverse mortgage subsidiary of Finance Of America Companies, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the home equity conversion mortgage servicing portfolio and additional reverse mortgage assets from PHH Mortgage, a subsidiary of Onity Group. The all-cash transaction aims to expand Finance of America’s servicing capabilities and reinforce its long-term relationship with Onity.

item.title: Sempresto Expands Intellectual Property Portfolio With Acquisition Of Third Autoinjector Platform
item.description: Sempresto has moved to strengthen its position in smartphone-integrated rescue medication technology through the acquisition of a third autoinjector platform, securing all patents and associated physical and digital assets from inventor Steven A. Friedman. The company said the newly acquired mechanisms and safety-enhancing features will support the development of next-generation, mobile-device-integrated drug delivery systems.

item.title: Centuri Expands Canadian Footprint With Acquisition Of Connect Atlantic Utility Services
item.description: Centuri Holdings has completed its acquisition of Connect Atlantic Utility Services Corporation, a leading electric utility services provider in Atlantic Canada, marking a significant expansion of Centuri’s capabilities and geographic reach. The transaction establishes Centuri as a dual electric and gas services provider across Canada for the first time, building upon the company’s existing natural gas distribution services delivered through its current subsidiary.

item.title: LearnUpon Acquires AI Learning Creation Platform Courseau
item.description: LearnUpon has acquired Courseau, an AI-assisted learning creation platform, marking a major strategic expansion for the Dublin-based learning technology company as it continues to scale its global presence and product capabilities.

item.title: Bedrock Data: $25 Million Series A Secured To Accelerate AI-Native Data Security Expansion
item.description: Bedrock Data has raised $25 million in Series A financing to accelerate the development and market expansion of its AI-native data security, governance, and management platform. Greylock Partners led the round with participation from Mangusta Capital, Mantis Venture Capital, Pier 88 Investment Partners, and additional investors. As part of the investment, Greylock partner Jason Risch has joined Bedrock Data’s board.
